messages:
Alex K.: Heads-up — customer AcmeCorp can't finish POC onboarding. SSO assertion accepted but users not provisioning via SCIM. Dedicated pool access stuck.
Maria C.: Details? is this Hosted API keys or Dedicated? customer env: VPC/private?
Alex K.: Dedicated pool, VPC. They hit SCIM 400 when creating user. SAML assertion shows email and name ok, but our logs show `externalId` missing in SCIM payload.
Olivia R.: Can you paste the raw SCIM request/response (sanitized)?
Alex K.: Pasted below (redacted):
```
POST /scim/v2/Users 400
Request: { "userName": "j.smith@acme.com", "name": {"givenName":"John"}} 
Response: {"schemas":["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:Error"],"detail":"Missing required attribute: externalId","status":"400"}
```
Jordan P.: Ok - looks like their Okta SCIM app isn't mapping `user.id` -> `externalId`. On Okta side that mapping is optional unless your SCIM requires it. We should accept `userName` as fallback or ask them to map the attribute.
Maria C.: Customer security wants minimal change in their IdP. Any workaround on our side to accept fallback? timeline is tight, demo tomorrow.
Olivia R.: Quick fix: enable fallback `externalId=userName` in the provisioning adapter. I can deploy a config change to the POC Dedicated tenant — quick toggle, no code. Anyone ok with temporary override?
Alex K.: :eyes: we need sign-off from customer and security. I can ask them to approve mapping or temporary override. If they refuse, will cause demo failure.
Jordan P.: If they won't change IdP, second option is to accept SCIM create with a generated externalId (hash of userName) but must record source and audit for compliance. That needs infra review (audit logs + retention) and PM approval.
Olivia R.: I can implement the toggle and the logging tag today, but need EngInfra approval for retention policy change.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: #INC-4821 provision-scim-externalId-fallback (links: https://jira.redwood/INC-4821)
Maria C.: I'll loop in customer security now. Alex — can you get them to confirm by EOD? If yes, Olivia can flip the toggle and we can finish POC.
Alex K.: On it. Pinged security contact and Okta admin. Will update thread.
Alex K.: Update 1799990035 — Okta admin approved mapping change instead of us toggling. They're pushing attribute mapping now.
Olivia R.: Great — once mapping lands, expect SCIM success within 30s. I'll watch logs.
Jordan P.: If anything else fails, collect Okta SAML metadata and SCIM logs and drop here.
Alex K.: Demo stands. Thanks team :tada:
